messages:
Rina - Partnerships: Quick sync 1: we need a compact onramp plan for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Deliverables: region demo windows, SKU review deadlines, and a simple risk flag (firmware/thermal/driver). Who can own the CSV?
Omar (HW): I can. Status snapshot: H100 NA mid-May; H200 EU late-May but per-rack density limited; B200 partners stagger into June; MI300 uncertain (tentative July); Gaudi pilots available for early-access. Will mark risks.
Zoe - Marketplace: SKU review needs 7 business days + legal 48h. Send a single CSV with columns: region,model,sku,listing_deadline,embargo_start,embargo_end,owner.
Kai - SI: For dry-runs we need 2 full integration days. Prefer NA first (H100 + Gaudi). Please provide `marketplace/preview:v2025-05-08` image and runbook. Also need fallback small-instance SKU.
ops-bot: Job queued: `preflight-deploy-check` 2025-04-20T02:00Z. If any firmware-risk=true, `staging-smoke` reserves 48h.
Rina - Partnerships: OK1 action: Omar = CSV by EOD; Zoe = block SKU review slot; Kai = tentative dry-run dates; ops-bot/ops = confirm smoke windows. Will draft comms after CSV in. :thumbsup:
